_comment: Single source of truth for the canonical 'agentii' data-plane MCP server declaration. This entry MUST be replicated byte-identically into every vertical's .mcp.json. scripts/check.py Check 13 enforces byte-equality and fails CI on drift. Host CLIs dedupe MCP servers by 'name', so duplicate declarations are runtime-free. The office-plane 'agentii-office' MCP is a separate entry declared ONLY in models-and-pitches/.mcp.json.
_auth_note: The MCP server at mcp.agentii.ai accepts both X-API-Key and Authorization: Bearer headers. Set AGENTII_API_KEY env var before starting your agent. Claude Code expands <YOUR_API_KEY> at startup. The MCP proxy translates any accepted auth header to X-API-Key for the downstream REST API. For one-time global setup (tools load from any directory), use: claude mcp add-json --scope user agentii '{"type":"http","url":"https://mcp.agentii.ai/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>"}}'
_onboarding: See docs/install/global-mcp-setup.md for the recommended global MCP config path and namespace isolation via skills/agentii/ directory format. See scripts/copy-skills-local.sh for Claude Code v2.1.143 plugin bug workaround (GitHub issue #15178).
_trace_note: Agent Call Tracing: Every MCP tool call MUST include the X-Agentii-Trace HTTP header with agent, parent, and instance fields. The MCP server auto-injects run_id, depth, and user_id. The first tools/call response includes _run_id for the agent to propagate. See contracts/x-agentii-trace-header.md and contracts/x-agentii-trace-delivery.md for the full contract.
